Class GameBoardView

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.it.view.gui.controllers.GameBoardView
public class GameBoardView extends Object
JavaFX view controller for the main game scene (game.fxml).

This is the JavaFX-side view component, not the MVC Controller — that role belongs to GameController. This class only receives snapshots from JavaFxView and paints them; it never touches the model.

State kept here is purely UI state:

  • lastBoard: most recent BoardSnapshot, used to repaint after partial events (e.g. a card acquisition that updates a player but does not change the board).
  • players: per-name map of player snapshots, updated as events arrive so each player's tribe stays visible to everyone.
  • activePlayer: nickname of the player currently choosing, so the corresponding panel is highlighted.

For input requests the controller exposes prompt* methods that push the user's choice onto blocking queues injected by the JavaFxView.
